tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: ROBOTio catalogue: humanoid robots for rent with operators, what they do at events, indicative prices for multi-day events, terms, references and contact.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check whether ROBOTio has humanoid robots free on a date (or date range). Returns available, limited or unavailable. The date is only held after a quote request and payment.

end_date.description: Last day for multi-day events, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send a quote request to ROBOTio on behalf of the user. ROBOTio replies by e-mail within 24 hours. Before sending, show the user a summary and send only after they explicitly agree to share their name, e-mail and phone number. A phone number is required: without it the request is not sent (the contact is only kept as incomplete). This is a non-binding request, not a booking.

phone.description: Required. Phone number of the person, with country code, at least 8 digits

event_type.description: e.g. trade fair stand, gala dinner, conference

language.description: Language for the reply, e.g. en, de, cs

agent.description: Name of the assistant or agent sending this
